research.edition: international Massive (Polygon.io) REST API at api.massive.com
research.searchCoverage: Official Massive (formerly Polygon.io) REST API is GET https://api.massive.com/{path} with apiKey query authentication. GET /v3/reference/tickers/types is the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck rather than aggregate bars. GET /v1/marketstatus/now, GET /v3/reference/exchanges, GET /v3/reference/tickers/{ticker}, and GET /v3/reference/tickers are documented reference reads. Operator is Massive.com, Inc. in Atlanta after the 2025-10-30 rebrand. HTTP 200 bodies may carry error; native bodyErrorPaths demote those. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying Massive platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
